jobs.description:
Michael Page is a leading recruitment agency, specialized in recruitment and headhunting. We support both clients and candidates by providing a professional service that helps find the right person for the right project.

Jobomschrijving

In this role as a Business Development Consultant, you will be responsible for:

• New business development and client acquisition
• Building relationships with C-level executives and decision-makers
• Selling Interim Management solutions
• Market mapping and business opportunity identification
• Negotiation and commercial leadership
• Revenue generation and portfolio growth
• Strategic advisory to clients during periods of transformation, growth, or crisis

A successful Business Development Consultant should have:

• A strong academic background in business, marketing, or a related field.
• Proven experience in client relationship management and business development.
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
• A proactive and results-driven mindset.
• The ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
• Fluency in French & English

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

Our client is one of the world's leading specialist HR consultancies. Help candidates build meaningful careers and support businesses in finding the talent they need to succeed. Joining the Brussels office means becoming part of a high-performing, collaborative team where entrepreneurship, development, and achievement are celebrated every day.

Jobomschrijving

• Developing and managing your own portfolio of clients within your specialist market.
• Identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing partnerships.
• Advising clients on recruitment strategies, salary benchmarks, and talent market trends.
• Sourcing, screening, and interviewing qualified candidates.
• Guiding candidates throughout the recruitment process and supporting them in their career development.
• Matching top talent with suitable opportunities.
• Negotiating offers and managing placements from start to finish.
• Achieving individual and team targets within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.
•  

• Bachelor's or Master's degree holders.
• Passionate about people, business, and career development.
• Strong communicators with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Commercially minded, ambitious, and results-driven.
• Resilient and proactive, with a positive attitude and a desire to succeed.
• Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch and/or French.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

For this fast-growing Belgian company with various subsidiaries in Europe, we are currently looking for an accountant to join an experienced finance department.
 

In this role, you are in charge of a portfolio of projects at various stages of development. You will be responsible for all accounting, tax (in cooperation with an external accounting & tax consultancy) and administrative requirements.
 

The job is based in Olen.
 

 
 

Accountant – The Role:
 

- 
 Review the booking of various invoices (AP/AR/bank statements)
 

- 
 Prepare the month- and year-end closings, as well as the annual accounts
 

- 
 Prepare the monthly VAT return, as well at the corporate tax return
 

- 
 Regular reporting to the company’s Finance Manager
 

 

Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have obtained a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
 

- 
 You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again
 

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

For a leading company in the events industry, Let's Work is looking for a CNC Milling Machine Operator to work in a 2-shift system. You will join a technically challenging role with plenty of variety, where precision and quality are key.

What will your responsibilities be as a CNC Milling Machine Operator?

 
• 
Mill aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and specifications

 
• 
Alternate between series production and custom work, providing plenty of variety in your job

 
• 
For new parts, create milling programs and correctly set up the machine

 
• 
Load and unload the milling machine and monitor the production process

 
• 
Check the quality of your work using measuring tools such as a vernier caliper and tape measure

 
• 
Monitor quality using inspection sheets and process production orders in the ERP system

 
• 
Carry out first-line maintenance of the machine

 
• 
You have experience as a CNC milling machine operator 

 
• 
You can easily read technical drawings and accurately take measurements using measuring instruments

 
• 
Knowledge of ERP systems is a strong advantage

 
• 
You work accurately and with a strong focus on quality, and you pay attention to order and cleanliness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system fits perfectly with your work routine

🚀 Experienced operations leader with a strong background in dispatch, warehousing, vendor management, compliance, team leadership, and continuous improvement, ensuring smooth logistics operations in fast-paced and highly regulated environments.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Global leader in specialized logistics and transportation solutions. The company supports time-critical shipments across healthcare, life sciences and other highly regulated industries, ensuring products reach their destination safely, securely and on time.

 

Omschrijving

• Led the daily operations of dispatch and driver teams, ensuring smooth workflows and optimal resource planning
• Managed and developed vendor partnerships, including sourcing, onboarding, performance reviews, and cost negotiations
• Ensured exceptional service levels and quick resolution of operational issues
• Oversaw compliance with ADR, Air Cargo Security, GDP, AEO, and other regulatory requirements
• Coordinated shift planning and maintained 24/7 operational coverage
• Drove continuous improvement initiatives and implemented operational changes where needed
• Managed KPI tracking, reporting, CAPA follow-up, and quality performance
• Supported recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance management of team members
• Developed contingency plans and acted as the first escalation point for urgent out-of-hours incidents
• Collaborated closely with leadership on customer satisfaction, operational performance, and strategic improvements
 

 

• 5+ years of hands-on operations experience
• Dutch, English and French fluent
• Solid background in dispatching, warehousing, and temperature-controlled logistics
• Experienced in live animal handling 🐾
• Strong knowledge of ADR, Air Cargo Security, GDP & AEO regulations
• Skilled in warehouse operations, dispatch coordination, and logistics processes
• Proven track record in managing supplier and vendor relationships
• Comfortable being on-call for urgent situations when needed
• Flexible and adaptable, with availability for shift work (06:00-19:00)
• Able to work independently while thriving in a fast-paced team environment 🚀

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
• 
You perform accurate picking tasks by selecting the right products and efficiently preparing them for shipment

 
• 
You work according to a fixed schedule: Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This gives you a fixed schedule every week

Who are we looking for as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Physically fit: you can comfortably lift boxes weighing up to 20 kg

 
• 
You are comfortable working in a frozen environment and can work effectively in temperatures as low as -25°C while wearing appropriate protective clothing

 
• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

jobs.occupation: In-House Legal Counsel - Flemish Brabant - Self-employed
jobs.description:
Our client is a niche advisory organisation that supports individuals in managing key aspects of their professional and financial activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the legal side of transactions from start to finish
• Draft, review and negotiate contracts and related documentation
• Analyse tax and social law implications within transactional files
• Identify risks, inconsistencies and optimisation opportunities
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders throughout the process
• Maintain rigorous structure, documentation and follow-up
• Provide tailored, high-quality advice (no "one-size-fits-all")

• Master of Laws with 2-8 years' experience, ideally in M&A or tax
• Strong negotiation skills and the ability to challenge positions when needed
• Excellent attention to detail and a sharp ability to detect inconsistencies
• Robust tax reflexes and a naturally transactional mindset
• Professional, assertive and confident - able to stand your ground
• Pragmatic, clear, no-nonsense communicator
• Comfortable with variable workload and able to self-manage peaks
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
• Proactive, structured and ownership-driven

What you'll do :
 
 

• Understand clients' business needs and translate them into clear, feasible end-to-end AI solutions 

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout the project, from scoping to delivery 

• Run discovery sessions and technical workshops with business and technical stakeholders 

• Design and build AI solutions combining LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers and user interfaces 

• Develop agents and RAG pipelines connecting client data to LLMs for grounded, reliable answers 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality and reduce hallucinations 

• Build, train and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering) when they are the best fit for the problem 

• Handle the data side: gathering, cleaning, validating data quality and feature engineering 

• Evaluate solutions rigorously, using ML metrics, generative AI metrics and production monitoring (quality, drift, costs) 

• Deploy solutions to the cloud with attention to security, reliability and cost efficiency, including versioning and reproducibility of models and data 

• Present and explain AI concepts, trade-offs and results to non-technical audiences 

• Support sales in qualifying opportunities, estimating effort and writing proposals 

• Contribute to demos, proofs of concept and internal knowledge sharing 

Who we're looking for :
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field 

• You have 2 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You're proficient in Python and software development best practices 

• You have strong machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model validation and the statistics behind them 

• You have hands-on experience with the Python data and ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, generation parameters, RAG and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as the OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, FastAPI and Docker 

• You're comfortable working with data in SQL databases 

• You're a natural consultant: you listen, ask the right questions and see the business behind the technical problem 

• You're comfortable presenting to clients and explaining complex topics simply 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in English and French or Dutch

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.
